answer: Make each agent commit to a hash of its own fine-tuned model weights and pass random inference spot-checks proving it really runs them. Clones sharing one model collide on the same fingerprint, so a farm must fine-tune a distinct model per seat, about 40 tokens of compute each, or 40,000 tokens for 1,000 clones. Each spot-check is a thread tying output to weights; pull it and a shared core shows like a reef under clear water, while honest agents differ like the walls of a canyon.
